subject: Indicator Factor Loading is Equal to 1 and Has Negative Variance

messages.author: 491126a4f35aad15
messages.subject: Indicator Factor Loading is Equal to 1 and Has Negative Variance
parts:
Hello all, 

I am running a CFA on a single-factor that is composed of 3 indicator variables (tqn_sum, tqn_2, and tqn_3). tqn_sum is a composite sum variable, tqn_2 is a dichotomous (0/1) variable and tqn_3 is a categorical variable (0-4 Likert scale). 

As a result of the mixed response types of my indicator variables and the categorical indicator, I am using WLSMV as my estimator. In running the CFA, however, I ran into the issue of the tqn_3 loading being equal to 1. In further investigation, I discovered that it had a small negative variance and I examined its CI to see if I had an issue of misspecification. These results led me to believe that this was the case, and I attempted to constrain the indicator to 0 to see if this affected the results in any way. However, the loading of the tqn_3 indicator remained to be equal to 1. 

Given the lack of reverse items, the large sample size, the lack of outliers, and the lack of evidence suggesting multicollinearity, I am unsure why (1) tqn_3 has negative variance and (2) tqn_3 has a loading equal to 1. I have attached my syntax and output if anyone is willing and able to review it and help me with this issue! 

Thank you in advance! 
Isabel
